summary: The county jail booked 19 people on criminal charges dated Thursday, Nov. 12, among them two family-violence arrests and a sheriff's office organized-retail-theft arrest. No new court releases, agency statements or news reports on Baldwin crime were found overnight.

entries.agency: Baldwin County Sheriff; Bay Minette Police
entries.title: Domestic arrests Nov. 12: Michael Dewayne Stewart, Johnny Frank Robinson Jr.
body: Michael Dewayne Stewart, 38, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 8:52 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, and Johnny Frank Robinson Jr., 48, was arrested by Bay Minette police at 11:29 a.m. the same day, according to the jail roster. No agency statement or news report was found for either arrest.

Stewart was booked on a theft charge and a charge of third-degree domestic violence involving criminal mischief — damaging property of a family or household member. Robinson was booked on a charge of harassing a family member. Both were in custody when the roster was read early Friday.

entries.title: Organized retail theft arrest: Lamon Arnold
body: Lamon Arnold, 52, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 11:13 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a charge of organized retail theft — stealing merchandise from stores, typically to resell it. He was in custody when the roster was read early Friday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 11–12: David Kish Lawrence, Ann Marie Clark, Alton Heath Burkett, Richard Earl Smith, Javonte Laushaun Armstrong, Elijah Luis Bentley
body: The sheriff's office arrested David Kish Lawrence, 59, at 1 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, and booked him on charges of possessing a synthetic narcotic, drug paraphernalia, tampering with physical evidence and failure to appear on a felony. Fairhope police arrested Ann Marie Clark, 48, at 9:29 a.m. Nov. 12 near Greeno Road; she was booked on charges of methamphetamine possession and drug paraphernalia. Gulf Shores police arrested Alton Heath Burkett, 45, at 6:16 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, on a methamphetamine possession charge.

Richard Earl Smith, 56, arrested by the sheriff's office at 11:08 p.m. Nov. 11, was booked on a charge of possessing dangerous drugs and an alias writ of arrest. Javonte Laushaun Armstrong, 24, arrested by the sheriff's office Nov. 11, was booked on a charge of unlawfully breaking into a vehicle. All five were in custody. Elijah Luis Bentley, 20, arrested by state troopers Nov. 11, was booked Nov. 12 on a reckless endangerment charge and released the same day. Those arrested Nov. 11 were booked into the jail Nov. 12. Information is from the jail roster and the Fairhope police arrest log.

entries.title: Indicted, elder financial exploitation: John McNider, Angel McNider
body: A Baldwin County grand jury has indicted John McNider, 56, and Angel McNider, 54, owners of an Orange Beach boat-lift business, on a combined eight counts of financial exploitation of the elderly, FOX10 reported Thursday, citing court documents filed this week. The station said the documents name six alleged victims and put the value in each case above $2,500.

FOX10 reported that John McNider also faces two counts of first-degree theft of property and Angel McNider one, and that both face an electronic stalking charge. Angel McNider's attorney told the station she has not spoken to the person named in that charge in three years. Both were released from the county jail; their arraignment is set for Jan. 20, the station reported.

entries.title: Domestic violence arrest: Ramero Deaundre Perdue
body: Ramero Deaundre Perdue, 38, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 4:05 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

The roster lists three counts of third-degree domestic violence — an assault, harassment or similar offence against a family or household member — along with third-degree criminal trespass and a third-degree assault/criminal mischief charge. He was in custody when the roster was read early Thursday.

entries.title: Death investigation: man found in water near Fairhope pier
body: Fairhope police said officers responded to a 911 call at about 7:45 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, and found a man dead in the water near a private pier on Sea Cliff Drive, FOX10 and WKRG reported. Police are investigating the death as a possible drowning.
Police said there was no indication of foul play. The man had not been identified publicly pending notification of his family.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 10–11: Kelvin Quantavious Culbreath, Brandon Allan Card, James Percy Blair II, Aynsleigh Nicole Aspen Howard
body: Foley police arrested Kelvin Quantavious Culbreath, 23, at 1:54 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, and booked him on charges of possessing dangerous drugs and second-degree marijuana possession; the roster shows him released Nov. 12. Foley police also arrested Brandon Allan Card, 44, at 9:16 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 10, on two counts of possessing dangerous drugs, marijuana possession and drug paraphernalia; the roster shows him released Nov. 11.

James Percy Blair II, 43, arrested by Daphne police Nov. 10, was booked into the county jail Nov. 11 on a charge of promoting prison contraband involving drugs — bringing drugs into a jail. Aynsleigh Nicole Aspen Howard, 21, was arrested by the sheriff's office at 12:42 a.m. Nov. 11 and booked on a charge of harassing a family member. Blair was in custody; the roster shows Howard released Nov. 12. All information is from the jail roster.
